material.commit_comment:
ui: close proposed-projectile-arc-client-display

Row: proposed-projectile-arc-client-display
Witness: 1793530933977-2078-a321a7d4211f69e5
Status: resolved
material.description: missile_arc is parsed in rust/crates/data loader.rs and read by no sim path. Parity row 17 says the arc has no outcome effect, so the sim requirement of proposed-sim-facing-turn-hold-patrol-projectile is met by display. Implement the arc in the client renderer (js/client) from the parsed value; no sim, state-hash or STATE_VERSION change. Acceptance: a basic-attack projectile of a unit whose data has missile_arc > 0 visibly arcs in the browser frame; CI green on the pushed sha; a client-only change with the 6.88g arc value cited in the commit body.

material.resolution: Client draws the missile_arc projectile lift (display only, no sim or state-hash change). Caveat: no pixel frame was captured (verb spool limit), so 'visibly' rests on the per-frame draw transform; spell_orb not exercised. Commit 226a623a touches only the row's own files.
material.subject: Client draws the 6.88g projectile arc from missile_arc (display only, no sim change)
material.witness: live run at 226a623a (localhost:8731, wasm built from the sha): drow_ranger shots (arc 0.05) drew with lift 4*arc*span*f*(1-f), exact to max error 0, peaking 0.56 units on an 11-unit flight; 1847 arc-0 frames had zero lift. CI run 41298288428 3/3 success on the sha.
